verdict.rationale: Conductor stores workspace state, chat history, and cloud workspace data, but no evidence in the pack shows an explicit data-export feature or open-format export guarantee; while code lives in git worktrees (inherently portable), there's no documentation of exporting chats, settings, or cloud workspace metadata. Community threads even raise unresolved concerns about data practices and lack of transparency (conductor-comm-3, conductor-comm-5), reinforcing the absence of an export/leave story.
